instruction.text: Select the sentence parts in the correct order to answer the question.

feedback.finish: Physical contact can be wanted, like a hug when you’re upset, or unwanted, like being pushed over in the playground.

atoms.finishSound: Physical contact is when one person’s body touches someone else’s body.

instruction.text: Decide which actions are examples of physical contact.

trainers.hint: Select an image to hear what the action is.

instruction.text: Select the three types of physical contact that are never okay.

feedback.end: If any of these things happen to you or someone you know, you must always report it to a trusted adult. This could be your parent or guardian, or a teacher at school.

b: ++someone touching you when you don’t want them to
++someone trying to touch your private parts
a grandparent holding your hand in public
helping a friend up when they have fallen

instruction.text: Who should you tell if something happens that you are not comfortable with?

feedback.finish:
If you feel like there is no one you trust enough to talk to, you can also call Childline and talk about what is going on. Their phone number is 0800 1111.

If you need help in an emergency, call 999 for the police.
